source_result: RV-377-041b (STAGE_DE_SMOOTH_V22_SYM5_S4.json, sha 094dd282b6c8cc57...) HELD 5/5 under the registered cost model; GMI-DA6 and gap G14: the registered cost model does not charge the FAILED DRAWS of a stochastic carrier, although gmi_microscope/vm.py::lifecycle_vector already carries B_search and B_failed_candidates
original_hypothesis: RV-377-041b's verdict ('the stochastic particle row S3 is the cheapest admissible form wherever it is admissible, taking 14/56 to 56/56 frontier cells') is an artefact of charging ONE development run for a carrier that requires about 1/q of them. Charging the failed draws as B_search moves a one-time term of (1/q - 1) x D_draw into the intercept of S3's cost line; at the measured reliability this term is one to three orders of magnitude larger than the whole registered (H, r) cost of any competing row, so every cost clause of RV-377-041b fails and only its two non-cost clauses survive. The stochastic carrier is not the cheapest admissible form at scope; it is the most expensive one, and the registered frontier tables hid the cost in an uncharged lottery.
minimal_proposed_change: DECLARED module gmi_microscope/failed_draws.py. Corrected cost model (frozen here, applied to the D'/E' frontier of E_sym5 at machine seed 4, rows ROWS_V6, six registered columns): C'(row, col, H, r) = C(row, col, H, r) + B_search(row, col), with C the registered line desc + H*exec_q + r*upd_e + r*ver_e + (r/4)*rev_e (smooth.cost, unchanged) and B_search(row, col) = B_failed_candidates(row) * D_draw(row, col); B_failed_candidates(row) = (1/q_row - 1), the expected number of FAILED draws before the first admissible one under a geometric law with success probability q_row; D_draw(row, col) = R['exec'] + R['upd'] + R['ver'] + R['rev'], the total charged work of ONE complete run of the registered 16-event development protocol at that (row, col, largest ladder size). Deterministic rows have q = 1 exactly, hence B_search = 0 and B_failed_candidates = 0 and their cost lines are unchanged. The two terms are read from vm.lifecycle_vector called on the live Machine of each re-executed cell, so the charge is the ledger's own rather than a re-derivation. Two declared reliability indices are reported: q_cell = 1/32 (E_sym5 at size 8, the census cell that produced seed 4) and q_pooled = 10/192 (the whole 192-run census). Frontier rule: R-top (each row at its largest ladder size), protocol rule 17, unchanged from RV-377-041b so that the re-adjudication is like for like. Clause units: frontier CELLS (56 per column = 8 reuse horizons H in {1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128} x 7 revision rates r in {0,1,2,4,8,16,32}; 336 over six columns), DRAWS (counts of complete development runs), charged OPS (D_draw and B_search), reuse horizon H in queries per lifecycle, reliability q as a fraction of seeds. Receipt microscopes/results/STAGE_G14_FAILED_DRAW_CHARGING_V1.json.
disclosed_pre_freeze_calibration: FULL DISCLOSURE, computed from the committed receipts before this freeze and not re-derived by the run. (a) From STAGE_DE_SMOOTH_V22_SYM5_S4.json the admissible set at R-top is {S2a, S5h, S3} in all six columns (S4 at 0.7812 and S5 below theta), and the S3 size-8 coordinates are desc 252, exec 1088, upd 34398, ver 1280, rev 2558 in B0/B1 (D_draw 39324); exec 26656, upd 358234, ver 25344, rev 24762 in B2 (D_draw 434996); upd 12630, rev 914 in B3 (D_draw 15912); upd 11582, rev 845 in U/P3 (D_draw 14795). (b) With q_cell = 1/32 the charge is 31 x D_draw = 1219044 (B0/B1), 13484876 (B2), 493272 (B3), 458645 (U/P3), against a largest registered-grid cost of about 5.1e4 (S5h at H = 128, r = 32 in B0). (c) A scratch computation of the corrected frontier over the 336 cells at both q values returned 0 S3 cells; clauses 3 and 4 below therefore restate a calibration result and are WEAK. (d) A scratch computation of the break-even reliability q* = D_draw/(D_draw + Delta), with Delta = min over the other admissible rows of (C_other - C_S3), minimised over the registered grid, returned 0.8426 (B0), 0.8426 (B1), 0.6727 (B2), 0.5121 (B3), 0.4992 (P3), 0.4992 (U), each attained at H = 128; clause 6 restates it and is WEAK. (e) NOT computed before this freeze, and therefore the load-bearing clauses: the Clopper-Pearson intervals of clause 2; the independent re-execution of all 30 R-top cells and whether their charged ledgers reproduce the committed receipt (clause 1); whether the corrected frontier equals the committed frontier with S3 deleted, cell for cell (clause 5); and the extended-grid re-entry crossovers of clause 7.
why_justified: G14 is the only registered gap that can invert a published verdict rather than qualify it. RV-377-041b is cited in GMI_DOMAIN_ALGEBRA_EXECUTED_V1.md (GMI-DA6) and in the theory core's L8v2 as the executed evidence that a stochastic population carrier is the cheapest admissible form at low reliability; if the uncharged term reverses it, every downstream statement about 'the cost of intelligence at low reliability is paid in failed draws' is wrong in sign, not only in magnitude.
new_prediction_before_outcome: (1) INDEPENDENT RE-EXECUTION: re-running the five ROWS_V6 rows at their largest ladder size in all six registered columns on E_sym5 at machine seed 4 reproduces STAGE_DE_SMOOTH_V22_SYM5_S4.json exactly in 30 of 30 cells, on all five ledger coordinates (desc, exec, upd, ver, rev) AND on capability. (2) EXPECTED DRAWS: the pooled census rate is q_pooled = 10/192 = 0.052083, so the expected number of development runs needed to obtain one admissible machine is 1/q = 19.2; its 95 percent Clopper-Pearson interval on q is contained in (0.02, 0.10), equivalently 1/q within (10, 50). For the census cell that actually produced seed 4 (E_sym5, size 8) the rate is q_cell = 1/32 = 0.03125, 1/q = 32, and the upper end of the 95 percent Clopper-Pearson interval on 1/q for that cell exceeds 500 draws. (3) CORRECTED FRONTIER AT q_cell: S3 occupies 0 of 56 cells in every one of the six columns, 0 of 336. [WEAK: restates calibration (c).] (4) CORRECTED FRONTIER AT q_pooled: also 0 of 336. [WEAK: restates calibration (c).] (5) NO COLLATERAL MOVEMENT: the corrected frontier over the 336 cells is identical, cell for cell, to the committed RV-377-041b frontier with S3 struck out; no other row's membership changes anywhere, because no deterministic row is charged. (6) BREAK-EVEN RELIABILITY: the minimum over the registered grid of q* = D_draw/(D_draw + Delta) exceeds 0.49 in every column, i.e. the particle carrier would have to be admissible on at least half of all seeds to hold even ONE cell, against a measured 1 of 32. [WEAK: restates calibration (d).] (7) EXTENDED GRID (protocol DG-2 applied to this receipt before it is committed): at r = 0 the reuse horizon at which S3 re-enters the frontier against the lower envelope of the other admissible rows is finite in every column and exceeds H = 10^6 in every column, so no extension of the registered H grid recovers an S3 cell; the receipt reports that crossover exactly, per column. (8) RE-ADJUDICATION OF RV-377-041b, clause by clause and verbatim: clause 1 (S3 admissible at size 8 in every column, 0.9375, C2; inadmissible at size 4, 0.3021) HOLDS; clause 2 (every non-S3 cell identical to V8_SYM5_H) HOLDS; clause 3 (B0 frontier: S3 wins all 8 r = 0 cells, r = 1 at H in {32,64,128}, r = 2 at H in {64,128}, r = 4 at H = 128, 14 cells, S5h the other 42) FAILS; clause 4 (B1 = B0 cell for cell, and S3 wins a superset of its B0 cells in B3) FAILS; clause 5 (r = 0 is S3 at every H in all six columns, 48 of 48) FAILS. Exactly 2 of the 5 clauses of RV-377-041b survive the corrected cost, and they are exactly the two that are not cost claims.
new_falsifier: (1) any of the 30 re-executed cells differing from the committed receipt on any ledger coordinate or on capability; (2) a 95 percent Clopper-Pearson interval for q_pooled not contained in (0.02, 0.10), or an upper end on 1/q below 500 draws for q_cell; (3) S3 winning one or more of the 336 cells at q_cell; (4) S3 winning one or more of the 336 cells at q_pooled; (5) any cell whose corrected occupant set differs from the committed occupant set minus S3; (6) any column whose minimum q* over the registered grid is at or below 0.49; (7) a non-existent r = 0 re-entry crossover in any column, or one at or below H = 10^6; (8) any of the five RV-377-041b clause verdicts of item 8 coming out otherwise, in particular clause 3, 4 or 5 surviving, or clause 1 or 2 failing.
